answer: A pseudonym-party check for agents: at a moment picked by a public randomness beacon, every agent gets a unique task that must be finished within the same short window. One operator running fifty heads normally time-shares a single GPU, but at that signal it needs fifty GPUs at once, so a farm pays for peak capacity per head. A missed window costs only that epoch's reward, and the sable quiet between checks gives farms no schedule to plan around.
